explanation: The Affiliate Amendment (effective 2025-10-15) moved Marrow Agrisupply to Tier 1, and the April 2026 renewal expressly left its SLA as set by that amendment. D002 (updated 2026-09-15) also lists SLA Tier 1. D115 says Tier 2 'like the parent', but that is an informal note and conflicts with the signed contract.
